_comment: Limits for the canvas benchmark (bench/canvas.bench.ts). Draw work is the time the page spends issuing draw commands in a frame; the share of slow frames counts frames over 20 ms. The interval p95 is reported but not gated: on a 60 Hz display it can only read 16.7 or 33.3 ms (see docs/spikes/phase-0-report.md). The share of slow frames has a wide margin because the headless software compositor on shared CI machines drops frames on its own (6 to 7 % in the unexplained 'drag 50 at 100 %' scenario, see the phase-0 report); draw work is the tight limit.
